entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Crash: xamarin_unhandled_exception_handler on iOS #32013
  • Getting bitcodestrip issue in iOS in Maui DotNet 9.0 #32008
  • end should be < than charSequence length #32004
  • WebAuthenticatorIntermediateActivity.onResume Still Crashes When Passed a Null Value #32000
  • [MAUI]I9_Scrolling - Clicking 'Scroll to Proboscis Monkey' button does not scroll to the correct position when 'ScrollToPosition' is set to 'MakVisible' #31997
  • Fail to run the WPF Blazor hybrid App with FileNotFoundException "Could not load file or assembly 'Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET, Version=10.0.17763.10" #32002
  • [.NET10][XAML inflator] `x:Reference` does not appear to work #31995

Closed

  • AppShell no longer working on iOS 26 #31982

PullRequests

Created

  • Sync .NET 9 SR12 with .NET 10 GA release #32012
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • Migrate SourceGen unit tests from NUnit to xUnit #32009

    t/bug, platform/android, platform/ios, area-controls-swipeview

    platform/macos, community ✨
  • [Android] Fix SafeArea padding calculation with AdjustPan and Container+SoftInput #31998
    t/bug, platform/android, area-keyboard

    area-testing

    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure
